ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Blue Desert
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
BLUEDESERT_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 7 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). The Blue Desert, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own instance is unaffected; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
From orbit the bluest thing on the planet; underfoot, colorless. A plateau of hydrocarbon ice with no water-based life and no soil: everything native here is a fuel charge stable only in the cold, and warmth is detonation. `workerClass` stays the vanilla Core `BiomeWorker_IceSheet` — the twin never named a donor type, so this mod owes no `RM_BiomeWorker_BlueDesert` of its own.
Ships the biome and its full resident cast, moved in unchanged from the frozen campaign twin: three hydrocarbon fauna (dorrak the Swallower, krissek the Burner, vekkit the Picker), three transparent fractal flora (palefloss, glassfern, chimeglobe), the shared cold-wax fuel product, their detonation-chain hediffs, and the krissek's blue-fire halo effecter — plus the mechanic C# that drives all of it (plant/fauna detonation, cold-wax warm-reactivity, the butane-gut ingestion penalty for foreign grazers). A Mod Settings screen gives a master toggle plus one switch per mechanic (native detonations, flora chain reactions, warm-reactive cold wax, butane gut, burner halo VFX) and the warm-detonation threshold slider, all defaulting to the shipped behavior (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1).
⚠️ Not entirely donor-free: three `wildPlants` rows (Alpha Biomes' `AB_ToxiGrass`/ `AB_CrystalHorn`, and `PoisonPlantTallGrass`) are inherited unguarded from the frozen campaign twin, same shape as the twin's own authoring — that ban-1 tension (this biome's own sheet forbids water-based flora) stays open for the owner and is not resolved by this build. `AA_Thunderbeast` (Alpha Animals, `sarg.alphaanimals`) ships inline, `MayRequire`-gated, matching how every other sibling RM_ biome mod ships its own non-Star-Wars donor rows directly (Q9).
NOT in this mod: `Vapaad`, a genuinely canon Star Wars creature (Vaapad) the campaign roster also ratifies for this biome — that rides a Utinni patch onto this mod's own `RM_BlueDesert` def instead, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling. The def's own prior comment called both `Vapaad` and `AA_Thunderbeast` "Star Wars rows"; only `Vapaad` actually is (`AA_Thunderbeast` is a plain Alpha Animals import with no Star Wars IP content), so only `Vapaad` is routed through the patch layer — see `WildAnimals_BlueDesert.xml`.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
